brief:
United Nations special rapporteurs said Israel continues committing what they characterized as "genocide" against Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported. The monitors cited approximately 160 Palestinian deaths during July alone, despite a ceasefire agreement in place during the month.

The UN officials pointed to the continued killings as evidence that Israel has not halted its military operations against Palestinian civilians and combatants. They did not elaborate on the specific circumstances surrounding individual deaths or provide a comprehensive breakdown of casualties by location or cause.
